text: Meaning: Everything I do — with my body, my words, my mind, my senses and my intellect — I offer to Sriman Narayana.
When the harathi is done, offer your namaskaram to Swamy.
Pray to be forgiven for any mistakes made in the puja, knowingly or unknowingly.
Ask Swamy to bless everyone in the family with long life and good health, and share the naivedyam as prasadam.
